# Muvap

> Muvap is David Berrocal's independent RevOps and GTM systems consultancy. Muvap designs and builds the revenue operations infrastructure that connects sales, marketing and data: lead scoring, CRM architecture, lifecycle stages, automation, AI agents and reporting, mainly on HubSpot.

## Company

- [About](https://davidbervic.com/about.html): Who Muvap is, real client engagements (MEDLIFE, CloudTask), martech stack.
- [Services](https://davidbervic.com/index.html#programs): Overview of the five Muvap programs.
- [Contact](https://davidbervic.com/contact.html): Book a call or message directly.

## Programs

Every program has three tiers with published Muvap fees (one time) and estimated monthly tool costs paid directly to vendors, a 6-phase delivery process (Discovery Call, Map, Architect, Deploy, Activate + Measure, Evolution Partner) and an optional Evolution Partner retainer ($1,500 to $3,000/mo).

- [GTM Architecture Evolution](https://davidbervic.com/gtm-architecture-evolution.html): CRM redesign, lifecycle stages, lead scoring, Clay + Apollo enrichment, and a CRM queried in natural language via Claude (MCP). Tiers: Foundation ($3,000 to $4,000), Scale ($5,700), Intelligence ($8,000 to $12,000). HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, GoHighLevel.
- [GTM Outbound Evolution](https://davidbervic.com/gtm-outbound-evolution.html): Email deliverability (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), ICP definition, Clay enrichment, AI-personalized multichannel sequences and intent signals. Tiers: Foundation ($3,000 to $4,500), Scale ($5,700), Intelligence ($8,000 to $12,000).
- [GTM Intelligence Evolution](https://davidbervic.com/gtm-intelligence-evolution.html): GA4, Looker Studio, BigQuery, multi-touch attribution and AI-written weekly briefs. Tiers: Foundation ($3,000 to $4,000), Integration ($5,700), Intelligence ($8,000 to $12,000).
- [GTM Workforce Evolution](https://davidbervic.com/gtm-workforce-evolution.html): n8n + Claude automations that save 5 to 10 hours of manual GTM work per week (efficiency, not lead generation). Tiers: Foundation ($3,000 to $4,500), Operational ($5,700), Advanced ($8,000 to $15,000).
- [GTM Total Glowap!](https://davidbervic.com/gtm-total-glowap.html): Full audit and prioritized roadmap across CRM, outbound, analytics and tool stack. Diagnostic ($1,500, one week), Architecture Sprint ($5,700 to $8,000), Full Evolution ($15,000 to $30,000 over 3 to 6 months).

## Case studies

- [How MEDLIFE built its first reliable revenue funnel on HubSpot](https://davidbervic.com/case-study.html?case=1): Lifecycle unification, lead scoring, CRM governance and AI agents for a global nonprofit.
- [How CloudTask turned HubSpot into the revenue engine of a two sided talent marketplace](https://davidbervic.com/case-study.html?case=2): Pipeline architecture, custom objects, multichannel outbound and answer engine optimization for a B2B RevOps marketplace.
